```{r}
# ---- Filter to Analysis Sample -----------------------------------------------
data_clean <- GATS_PK_raw %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(D01) | !is.na(D09) | !is.na(D08) | !is.na(D16),   # quit attempt OR intention
    !if_all(any_of(c(pk_media_smoke_cols, pk_hwl_smoke_col,
                     pk_media_slt_cols, pk_hwl_slt_col)), is.na)
  )
nrow(data_clean)
```


```{r}
# ---- Quit Attempts -----------------------------------------------------------
data_clean <- data_clean %>%
  mutate(
    quit_smoking = case_when(
      D01 == 1 ~ 1,
      D01 == 2 ~ 0,
      D01 %in% c(7, 9) | is.na(D01) ~ NA_real_
    ),
    quit_smokeless = case_when(
      D09 == 1 ~ 1,
      D09 == 2 ~ 0,
      D09 %in% c(7, 9) | is.na(D09) ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# ---- Quit Intentions ---------------------------------------------------------
data_clean <- data_clean %>%
  mutate(
    quit_smoking_intent = case_when(
      D08 %in% c(1, 2) ~ 1,
      D08 %in% c(3, 4) ~ 0,
      D08 %in% c(7, 9) | is.na(D08) ~ NA_real_
    ),
    quit_slt_intent = case_when(
      D16 %in% c(1, 2) ~ 1,

      D16 %in% c(7, 9) | is.na(D16) ~ NA_real_
```

```{r}
# ---- Tobacco User Type -------------------------------------------------------
# Current use only, per standard GATS definitions (B01, C01).
# Waterpipe excluded: the Pakistan WP module (WP1, WP2) captures PAST use only
# and is administered to ever-smokers, so current waterpipe use is not identifiable.
data_clean <- data_clean %>%
  mutate(
    smoker    = if_else(B01 %in% c(1, 2), 1, 0, missing = 0),
    smokeless = if_else(C01 %in% c(1, 2), 1, 0, missing = 0),

    user_type = case_when(
      smoker == 1 & smokeless == 1 ~ "Dual: Smoker + Smokeless",
      smoker == 1                  ~ "Smoker only",
      smokeless == 1               ~ "Smokeless only",
      TRUE                         ~ NA_character_
    ),

    user3 = case_when(
      user_type == "Smoker only"               ~ "Smoker",
      user_type == "Smokeless only"            ~ "Smokeless",
      user_type == "Dual: Smoker + Smokeless"  ~ "Dual"
    ),
    dual_use = if_else(user_type == "Dual: Smoker + Smokeless", 1L, 0L)
  )

# User type distribution
data_clean %>%
  count(user_type, name = "n", sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 2))

# Sanity check: should return 0 — everyone in data_clean answered D01 or D09,
# so everyone must be a current smoker or current SLT user
sum(is.na(data_clean$user_type))
```



```{r}
# ---- Demographics ------------------------------------------------------------
data_clean <- data_clean %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      age >= 15 & age <= 24 ~ "15-24",
      age >= 25 & age <= 44 ~ "25-44",
      age >= 45 & age <= 64 ~ "45-64",
      age >= 65 ~ "65+",
            TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
    %>% factor(levels = c("15-24","25-44","45-64","65+")),
    
    gender = case_when(
      A01 == 1 ~ "Male",
      A01 == 2 ~ "Female"
    ),
    
  education = case_when(
      A04 == 1               ~ "No Education",
      A04 %in% c(2, 3, 4)    ~ "Primary or Less",
      A04 %in% c(5, 6, 7, 8) ~ "Secondary or above",
      TRUE                   ~ NA_character_          # includes 77, 99 (don't know/refused)
    ),

    # Collapsed employment (2 categories: self-employed merged into employed)
    employment = case_when(
      A05 %in% c(1, 2, 3)    ~ "Employed",         # Govt/Non-govt/Daily wage/Self-employed
      A05 %in% c(4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9) ~ "Not Working",      # Student/Homemaker/Retired/Unemployed
      A05 %in% c(77, 99)        ~ NA_character_        # Unknown → missing
    ),
    
  residence_label = case_when(
      residence == 1 ~ "Urban",
      residence == 2 ~ "Rural"
    ),
  )

# Check demographic variables
data_clean %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_gender = n_distinct(gender, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_education = n_distinct(education, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_residence = n_distinct(residence, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_employment = n_distinct(employment, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# TABLE 1: DEMOGRAPHIC CHARACTERISTICS BY TOBACCO USER TYPE
# ==============================================================================

cats <- c("Smoker","Smokeless","Dual")
demo_vars <- c("gender","age_group","education","employment","residence_label")

var_labels <- c(
  gender      = "Gender",
  age_group   = "Age group",
  education   = "Education",
  employment  = "Employment",
 residence_label   = "Residence"
)

# Helper function
as_char_with_missing <- function(x) as.character(x)

# Guard: every user3 value must be a declared level, or the factor() call
# below will silently convert it to NA and drop those rows from Table 1
stopifnot(all(na.omit(unique(as.character(data_clean$user3))) %in% cats))

# Ensure user3 levels
tbl1_data <- data_clean %>%
  mutate(user3 = factor(user3, levels = cats))

# Unweighted counts
get_demo_counts_user3 <- function(df, var){
  stopifnot(var %in% names(df))
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(user3)) %>%
    mutate(`__cat__` = as_char_with_missing(.data[[var]])) %>%   # .data, not df
    filter(!is.na(`__cat__`)) %>%
    count(`__cat__`, user3, name = "n") %>%
    complete(`__cat__`, user3 = factor(cats, levels = cats), fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = user3, values_from = n) %>%
    mutate(
      Category_Total = rowSums(across(all_of(cats)), na.rm = TRUE),
      Variable = var
    ) %>%
    rename(Category = `__cat__`) %>%
    select(Variable, Category, Category_Total, all_of(cats))
}

table1_counts <- bind_rows(lapply(demo_vars, function(v) get_demo_counts_user3(tbl1_data, v)))

# Weighted column percentages
get_weighted_colpct_user3 <- function(pk_design, var){
  x <- pk_design$variables[[var]]
  x_fac <- factor(as_char_with_missing(x))
  pk_v <- do.call(update, c(list(pk_design), setNames(list(x_fac), var)))
  levs <- levels(x_fac)
  
  out <- data.frame(Category = levs, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  for (cat in cats) {
    d_cat <- subset(pk_v, user3 == cat)
    if (length(weights(d_cat)) == 0) {
      est_vec <- rep(NA_real_, length(levs))
      se_vec  <- rep(NA_real_, length(levs))
    } else {
      est <- svymean(as.formula(paste0("~", var)), d_cat, na.rm = TRUE)
      se  <- SE(est)
      est_vec <- as.numeric(est) * 100
      se_vec  <- as.numeric(se) * 100
      
      if (length(est_vec) != length(levs)) {
        nm <- names(est)
        lvl_from_names <- substring(nm, nchar(var) + 1)
        aligned <- rep(NA_real_, length(levs))
        aligned_se <- rep(NA_real_, length(levs))
        for (i in seq_along(lvl_from_names)) {
          j <- match(lvl_from_names[i], levs)
          if (!is.na(j)) {
            aligned[j] <- est_vec[i]
            aligned_se[j] <- se_vec[i]
          }
        }
        est_vec <- aligned
        se_vec <- aligned_se
      }
    }
    out[[paste0(cat, "_pct")]] <- est_vec
    out[[paste0(cat, "_se")]] <- se_vec
  }
  
  out$Variable <- var
  tibble::as_tibble(out)
}

table1_weighted <- bind_rows(lapply(demo_vars, function(v) get_weighted_colpct_user3(pk_design, v)))
```


```{r}
# ---- Design-adjusted (Rao-Scott) chi-square: smokers vs SLT users -----------
# Dual users excluded (sparse cells); one p-value per variable.
get_table1_pval <- function(design, var){
  d <- subset(design, user3 %in% c("Smoker","Smokeless") &
                      !is.na(design$variables[[var]]))
  t <- svychisq(as.formula(paste0("~", var, " + user3")), d, statistic = "F")
  tibble::tibble(Variable = var,
                 p = ifelse(t$p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", t$p.value)))
}

table1_pvals <- bind_rows(lapply(demo_vars, function(v) get_table1_pval(pk_design, v))) %>%
  mutate(Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, !!!var_labels))

# Join and format
table1_joined <- table1_counts %>%
  left_join(table1_weighted, by = c("Variable","Category")) %>%
  mutate(
    across(ends_with("_pct"), ~replace_na(., 0)),
    across(ends_with("_se"), ~replace_na(., 0)),
    Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, !!!var_labels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(Variable, levels = unname(var_labels)), Category) %>%
  left_join(table1_pvals, by = "Variable") %>%          # <- p-value joined here
  group_by(Variable) %>%
  mutate(
    p        = if_else(row_number() == 1, p, ""),        # show only on first row of block
    Variable = if_else(row_number() == 1, Variable, "")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
n_user3 <- data_clean %>% filter(!is.na(user3)) %>% nrow()

# Format for display
fmt_pct_se <- function(p, s){
  ifelse(is.na(p), "", sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", p, s))
}

table1_disp <- table1_joined %>%
  mutate(
    Smoker_pctSE    = fmt_pct_se(Smoker_pct, Smoker_se),
    Smokeless_pctSE = fmt_pct_se(Smokeless_pct, Smokeless_se),
    Dual_pctSE      = fmt_pct_se(Dual_pct, Dual_se)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Variable, Category, Category_Total,
    Smoker, Smoker_pctSE,
    Smokeless, Smokeless_pctSE,
    Dual, Dual_pctSE,
    p  
  )
table1_disp %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Table 1. Demographic characteristics by tobacco user type for Pakistan",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Unweighted counts and survey-weighted column percentages (SE). ",
      "Analysis limited to non-missing user type (N = ", format(n_user3, big.mark=","), ")."
    )
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Variable = "Variable",
    Category = "Category",
    Category_Total = "Row Total",
    Smoker = "n",
    Smoker_pctSE = "% (SE)",
    Smokeless = "n",
    Smokeless_pctSE = "% (SE)",
    Dual = "n",
    Dual_pctSE = "% (SE)",
    p = "p-value"
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Smoker", id = "sp_Smoker", columns = c(Smoker, Smoker_pctSE)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Smokeless", id = "sp_Smokeless", columns = c(Smokeless, Smokeless_pctSE)) %>%
 tab_spanner(label = "Dual", id = "sp_Dual", columns = c(Dual, Dual_pctSE)) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(Category_Total, Smoker, Smokeless, Dual), decimals = 0) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
  ) %>%
  tab_source_note("Note: Percentages are survey-weighted column percentages within each user type. 'Dual' refers to respondents who currently use both smoked and smokeless tobacco.p-values from design-adjusted (Rao-Scott) chi-square tests comparing smokers with smokeless tobacco users; dual users excluded owing to small cell sizes.")

```



```{r}
make_expo <- function(df, items){
  any_yes   <- rowSums(across(all_of(items), ~ . == 1), na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  any_valid <- rowSums(across(all_of(items), ~ . %in% c(1,2)), na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  dplyr::case_when(
    any_yes              ~ 1,
    any_valid & !any_yes ~ 0,
    TRUE                 ~ NA_real_
  )
}

data_clean <- data_clean %>%
  mutate(
    anti_cig_expo = make_expo(., c("G201a1","G201b1","G201c1","G201d1","G201e1","G202")),
    anti_slt_expo = make_expo(., c("G201a2","G201b2","G201c2","G201d2","G201e2","G202a")),
    anti_tob_expo = make_expo(., c("G201a1","G201b1","G201c1","G201d1","G201e1","G202",
                                   "G201a2","G201b2","G201c2","G201d2","G201e2","G202a"))
  )
```

```{r}
ensure_levels_pk <- function(des) {
  update(
    des,
    age_group  = factor(age_group, levels = c("15-24","25-44","45-64","65+")),
    gender     = factor(gender, levels = c("Female","Male")),
    education  = factor(education, levels = c("No Education","Primary or Less","Secondary or above")),
   residence_label = factor(residence_label, levels = c("Rural","Urban")),
    employment = factor(employment, levels = c("Not Working","Employed"))
  )
}

# Same user_type groupings used in your quit-items missingness check
smoker_types_pk <- c("Smoker only", "Dual: Smoker + Smokeless")
slt_types_pk    <- c("Smokeless only", "Dual: Smoker + Smokeless")

smokers_pk <- subset(pk_design, user_type %in% smoker_types_pk) %>% ensure_levels_pk()
slt_pk     <- subset(pk_design, user_type %in% slt_types_pk)    %>% ensure_levels_pk()

cat("SLT users (Pakistan):", nrow(slt_pk$variables), "\n")
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS TO BUILD FORMATTED TABLES
# ==============================================================================

tidy_or_stars <- function(model) {
  broom::tidy(model, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      stars = case_when(
        p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE            ~ ""
      ),
      `aOR (95% CI)` = ifelse(
        term == "(Intercept)", "",
        paste0(round(estimate, 2),
               " (", round(conf.low, 2), "\u2013", round(conf.high, 2), ")",
               stars)
      ),
      p = ifelse(
        term == "(Intercept)", "",
        ifelse(p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p.value))
      )
    ) %>%
    select(term, `aOR (95% CI)`, p)
}

recode_terms_pk <- function(df, exposure_term, exposure_label) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      Level = dplyr::recode(term,
        "(Intercept)"                       = "Intercept",
        !!exposure_term                     := exposure_label,
        "age_group25-44"                    = "25\u201344",
        "age_group45-64"                    = "45\u201364",
        "age_group65+"                      = "65+",
        "genderMale"                        = "Male",
      "educationPrimary or Less"    = "Primary or Less",
        "educationSecondary or above" = "Secondary or above",
        "residence_labelUrban" = "Urban",
        "employmentEmployed"          = "Employed",
       "dual_use"                          = "Dual use",
        .default = term
      ),
      Predictor = case_when(
        Level == exposure_label                                    ~ "Anti-Tobacco Exposure",
        Level %in% c("25\u201344", "45\u201364", "65+")            ~ "Age Group",
        Level == "Male"                                             ~ "Sex",
        Level %in% c("Primary or Less", "Secondary or above")     ~ "Education",
        Level == "Urban"                                            ~ "Residence",
        Level == "Employed"                                        ~ "Employment",
      Level == "Dual use"                                        ~ "Dual Use",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
}

build_pk_or_table <- function(model_attempt, model_intent,
                               exposure_term, exposure_label,
                               table_num, table_title, footnote_text) {

  attempt_or <- tidy_or_stars(model_attempt) %>%
    rename(`Quit Attempt aOR (95% CI)` = `aOR (95% CI)`,
           `Quit Attempt p` = p)

  intent_or <- tidy_or_stars(model_intent) %>%
    rename(`Quit Intention aOR (95% CI)` = `aOR (95% CI)`,
           `Quit Intention p` = p)

  combined <- attempt_or %>%
    full_join(intent_or, by = "term") %>%
    recode_terms_pk(exposure_term = exposure_term, exposure_label = exposure_label)

  ref_rows <- tibble::tribble(
    ~Predictor,   ~Level,                     ~`Quit Attempt aOR (95% CI)`, ~`Quit Attempt p`, ~`Quit Intention aOR (95% CI)`, ~`Quit Intention p`,
    "Age Group",  "15\u201324 (Reference)",   "\u2014", "", "\u2014", "",
    "Sex",        "Female (Reference)",       "\u2014", "", "\u2014", "",
    "Education",  "No Education (Reference)", "\u2014", "", "\u2014", "",
    "Residence",  "Rural (Reference)",        "\u2014", "", "\u2014", "",
    "Employment", "Not Working (Reference)",  "\u2014", "", "\u2014", ""
  )

  final_tab <- bind_rows(
    ref_rows,
    combined %>%
      filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
      select(Predictor, Level,
             `Quit Attempt aOR (95% CI)`, `Quit Attempt p`,
             `Quit Intention aOR (95% CI)`, `Quit Intention p`)
  ) %>%
    mutate(Predictor = factor(Predictor,
      levels = c("Anti-Tobacco Exposure", "Age Group", "Sex",
                 "Education", "Residence", "Employment", "Dual Use")   # <- added "Dual Use"
    )) %>%
    arrange(Predictor) %>%
    mutate(
      Level = if_else(is.na(Level), "", Level),
      across(c(`Quit Attempt aOR (95% CI)`, `Quit Attempt p`,
               `Quit Intention aOR (95% CI)`, `Quit Intention p`),
             ~ if_else(is.na(.), "", .))
    ) %>%
    group_by(Predictor) %>%
    mutate(Predictor_display = if_else(row_number() == 1, as.character(Predictor), "")) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(Predictor = Predictor_display, Level,
           `Quit Attempt aOR (95% CI)`, `Quit Attempt p`,
           `Quit Intention aOR (95% CI)`, `Quit Intention p`)

  knitr::kable(
    final_tab,
    align   = "llcccc",
    caption = paste0("Table ", table_num, ". ", table_title)
  ) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# TABLES 2 & 3: WEIGHTED EXPOSURE PREVALENCE BY SOCIODEMOGRAPHIC GROUP
# ==============================================================================
exposure_by_demo <- function(design, exposure_var, demo_vars, var_labels, min_n = 10) {

  # design-adjusted (Rao-Scott) chi-square: exposure across each variable's categories
  # self-employed excluded from the employment test (sparse cells)
  get_p <- function(v) {
    d <- subset(design, !is.na(design$variables[[v]]) &
                        !is.na(design$variables[[exposure_var]]))
    if (v == "employment") d <- subset(d, employment != "Self-Employed")
    t <- svychisq(as.formula(paste0("~", v, " + ", exposure_var)), d, statistic = "F")
    ifelse(t$p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", t$p.value))
  }

  purrr::map_dfr(demo_vars, function(v) {
    f_out <- as.formula(paste0("~", exposure_var))
    f_by  <- as.formula(paste0("~", v))
    des_v <- subset(design, !is.na(design$variables[[v]]) &
                            !is.na(design$variables[[exposure_var]]))
    est <- svyby(f_out, f_by, des_v, svyciprop,
                 vartype = "ci", method = "logit", na.rm = TRUE)
    ns <- des_v$variables %>%
      count(.data[[v]], name = "n_unwt") %>%
      rename(Category = 1)

    p_val <- get_p(v)

    tibble::tibble(
      Variable = unname(var_labels[v]),
      Category = as.character(est[[1]]),
      pct      = as.numeric(est[[2]]) * 100,
      lo       = est$ci_l * 100,
      hi       = est$ci_u * 100
    ) %>%
      left_join(ns, by = "Category") %>%
      mutate(
        Estimate = if_else(
          n_unwt < min_n,
          "\u2014",
          sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f\u2013%.1f)", pct, lo, hi)
        ),
        p = if_else(row_number() == 1, p_val, "")   # p on first row of each variable block
      ) %>%
      select(Variable, Category, Estimate, n_unwt, p)
  })
}

# Table 2 — anti-cigarette exposure among current smokers
table2 <- exposure_by_demo(smokers_pk, "anti_cig_expo", demo_vars, var_labels)

# Table 3 — anti-SLT exposure among current SLT users
table3 <- exposure_by_demo(slt_pk, "anti_slt_expo", demo_vars, var_labels)

table2
table3
```

```{r}
rates <- function(design, var) {
  d <- subset(design, !is.na(design$variables[[var]]))
  e <- svyciprop(as.formula(paste0("~", var)), d, method = "logit")
  data.frame(variable = var, n = nrow(d$variables),
             pct = round(as.numeric(e) * 100, 1),
             lo  = round(confint(e)[1] * 100, 1),
             hi  = round(confint(e)[2] * 100, 1))
}

bind_rows(
  rates(smokers_pk, "quit_smoking"),
  rates(smokers_pk, "quit_smoking_intent"),
  rates(slt_pk,     "quit_smokeless"),
  rates(slt_pk,     "quit_slt_intent")
)
```

```{r}
# ---- Tobacco User Type (RESTRICTED to Smoker / Smokeless / Dual, matching Pakistan) ----
in_clean <- in_clean %>%
  mutate(
    smoker = if_else(
      B01 %in% c(1, 2) | B03 %in% c(1, 2) |
        rowSums(across(c(B06A, B06B, B06C, B06E, B06F, B06G,
                         B10A, B10B, B10C, B10E, B10F, B10G),
                       ~ . > 0 & . < 888), na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      1, 0, missing = 0
    ),
    smokeless = if_else(
      C01 %in% c(1, 2) | C03 %in% c(1, 2) |
        rowSums(across(c(C06A, C06B, C06C, C06D, C06E, C06F, C06G,
                         C10A, C10B, C10C, C10D, C10E, C10F, C10G),
                       ~ . > 0 & . < 888), na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      1, 0, missing = 0
    ),

    # NOTE: waterpipe/e-cig kept only as diagnostic indicators — NOT used in user_type
    waterpipe  = if_else(WP0 %in% c(1, 2), 1, 0, missing = 0),
    ecigarette = if_else(EC2 %in% c(1, 2), 1, 0, missing = 0),

    # Restricted 3-category classification — mirrors Pakistan exactly
    user_type = case_when(
      smoker == 1 & smokeless == 1 ~ "Dual: Smoker + Smokeless",
      smoker == 1                  ~ "Smoker only",
      smokeless == 1               ~ "Smokeless only",
      TRUE                         ~ NA_character_   # waterpipe-only/e-cig-only/non-users excluded
    ),

    user3 = case_when(
      user_type == "Smoker only"              ~ "Smoker",
      user_type == "Smokeless only"           ~ "Smokeless",
      user_type == "Dual: Smoker + Smokeless" ~ "Dual"
    ),
    dual_use = if_else(user_type == "Dual: Smoker + Smokeless", 1L, 0L)
  )

# User type distribution
in_clean %>%
  count(user_type, name = "n", sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 2))

# Diagnostic: how many respondents are waterpipe-only/e-cig-only and now excluded?
in_clean %>%
  filter(is.na(user_type)) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), pct_of_sample = round(100 * n / nrow(in_clean), 2))
```

```{r}
in_clean <- in_clean %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      AGE >= 15 & AGE <= 24 ~ "15-24",
      AGE >= 25 & AGE <= 44 ~ "25-44",
      AGE >= 45 & AGE <= 64 ~ "45-64",
      AGE >= 65             ~ "65+",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("15-24","25-44","45-64","65+")),

    gender = case_when(
      A01 == 1 ~ "Male",
      A01 == 2 ~ "Female"
    ),

    # Collapsed to 3 categories — matches Pakistan
    education = case_when(
      A04 == 1               ~ "No Education",
      A04 %in% c(2, 3, 4)    ~ "Primary or Less",
      A04 %in% c(5, 6, 7, 8) ~ "Secondary or above",
      TRUE                   ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # Collapsed to 2 categories (self-employed folded into Employed) — matches Pakistan
    employment = case_when(
      A05 %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4)      ~ "Employed",          # Govt + Non-govt + Daily wage + Self-employed
      A05 %in% c(5, 6, 7, 8, 9) ~ "Not Working",       # Student/Homemaker/Retired/Unemployed
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    residence_label = case_when(
      Residence == 1 ~ "Urban",
      Residence == 2 ~ "Rural",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

    n_gender = n_distinct(gender, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_education = n_distinct(education, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_residence = n_distinct(residence_label, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_employment = n_distinct(employment, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# FLOW DIAGRAM NUMBERS — INDIA
# ==============================================================================

n_total_in <- nrow(GATS_IND_raw)

tobacco_user_flow_in <- GATS_IND_raw %>%
  mutate(
    smoker_flow = if_else(
      B01 %in% c(1, 2) | B03 %in% c(1, 2) |
        rowSums(across(c(B06A, B06B, B06C, B06E, B06F, B06G,
                         B10A, B10B, B10C, B10E, B10F, B10G),
                       ~ . > 0 & . < 888), na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      1, 0, missing = 0
    ),
    smokeless_flow = if_else(
      C01 %in% c(1, 2) | C03 %in% c(1, 2) |
        rowSums(across(c(C06A, C06B, C06C, C06D, C06E, C06F, C06G,
                         C10A, C10B, C10C, C10D, C10E, C10F, C10G),
                       ~ . > 0 & . < 888), na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      1, 0, missing = 0
    ),
    any_tobacco_user = if_else(smoker_flow == 1 | smokeless_flow == 1, 1, 0)
  )

n_any_user_in <- sum(tobacco_user_flow_in$any_tobacco_user)
cat("India — Current tobacco user:", n_any_user_in,
    sprintf("(%.1f%% of total)", 100 * n_any_user_in / n_total_in), "\n")

n_analytic_in <- tobacco_user_flow_in %>%
  filter(any_tobacco_user == 1) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(D01) | !is.na(D09),
    !if_all(any_of(c(in_media_smoke_cols, in_hwl_smoke_col,
                     in_media_slt_cols, in_hwl_slt_col)), is.na)
  ) %>%
  nrow()

cat("India — Analytic sample:", n_analytic_in,
    sprintf("(%.1f%% of tobacco users)", 100 * n_analytic_in / n_any_user_in), "\n")
cat("India — Excluded tobacco users:", n_any_user_in - n_analytic_in, "\n")

cat("Model N (India smoking quit attempt):   ", length(model_smk_attempt_in$y), "\n")
cat("Model N (India smoking quit intention): ", length(model_smk_intent_in$y), "\n")
cat("Model N (India SLT quit attempt):       ", length(model_slt_attempt_in$y), "\n")
cat("Model N (India SLT quit intention):     ", length(model_slt_intent_in$y), "\n")

# ==============================================================================
# OVERALL EXPOSURE + QUIT RATES — INDIA (mirrors Pakistan's rates() calls)
# ==============================================================================

rates <- function(design, var) {
  d <- subset(design, !is.na(design$variables[[var]]))
  e <- svyciprop(as.formula(paste0("~", var)), d, method = "logit")
  data.frame(variable = var, n = nrow(d$variables),
             pct = round(as.numeric(e) * 100, 1),
             lo  = round(confint(e)[1] * 100, 1),
             hi  = round(confint(e)[2] * 100, 1))
}

bind_rows(
  rates(smokers_in, "anti_cig_expo"),
  rates(slt_in,     "anti_slt_expo"),
  rates(smokers_in, "quit_smoking"),
  rates(smokers_in, "quit_smoking_intent"),
  rates(slt_in,     "quit_smokeless"),
  rates(slt_in,     "quit_slt_intent")
)
```

```{r}
# ---- Tobacco User Type (RESTRICTED to Smoker / Smokeless / Dual, matching Pakistan) ----
ba_clean <- ba_clean %>%
  mutate(
    smoker = if_else(
      B01 %in% c(1, 2) | B03 %in% c(1, 2) |
        rowSums(across(c(B06A, B06H, B06F, B06B, B06D, B06E, B06G,
                         B10A, B10H, B10F, B10B, B10D, B10E, B10G),
                       ~ . > 0 & . < 888), na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      1, 0, missing = 0
    ),
    smokeless = if_else(
      C01 %in% c(1, 2) | C03 %in% c(1, 2) |
        rowSums(across(c(C06A, C06B, C06C, C06D, C06E, C06F, C06G,
                         C10A, C10B, C10C, C10D, C10E, C10F, C10G),
                       ~ . > 0 & . < 888), na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      1, 0, missing = 0
    ),

    # NOTE: e-cigarette kept only as diagnostic indicator — NOT used in user_type
    ecigarette = if_else(EC2 %in% c(1, 2), 1, 0, missing = 0),

    # Restricted 3-category classification — mirrors Pakistan exactly
    user_type = case_when(
      smoker == 1 & smokeless == 1 ~ "Dual: Smoker + Smokeless",
      smoker == 1                  ~ "Smoker only",
      smokeless == 1               ~ "Smokeless only",
      TRUE                         ~ NA_character_   # e-cig-only/non-users excluded
    ),
user3 = case_when(
      user_type == "Smoker only"              ~ "Smoker",
      user_type == "Smokeless only"           ~ "Smokeless",
      user_type == "Dual: Smoker + Smokeless" ~ "Dual"
    ),
    dual_use = if_else(user_type == "Dual: Smoker + Smokeless", 1L, 0L)
  )

# User type distribution
ba_clean %>%
  count(user_type, name = "n", sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 2))

# Diagnostic: how many e-cig-only/non-users now excluded?
ba_clean %>%
  filter(is.na(user_type)) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), pct_of_sample = round(100 * n / nrow(ba_clean), 2))
```

```{r}
# ---- Demographics ---------------------------------------------------------------
ba_clean <- ba_clean %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      AGE >= 15 & AGE <= 24 ~ "15-24",
      AGE >= 25 & AGE <= 44 ~ "25-44",
      AGE >= 45 & AGE <= 64 ~ "45-64",
      AGE >= 65             ~ "65+",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("15-24","25-44","45-64","65+")),

    # Collapsed to 3 categories — matches Pakistan
    education = case_when(
      A04 == 1               ~ "No Education",
      A04 %in% c(2, 3, 4)    ~ "Primary or Less",
      A04 %in% c(5, 6, 7, 8) ~ "Secondary or above",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # Collapsed to 2 categories (self-employed folded into Employed) — matches Pakistan
    employment = case_when(
      A05 %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12)          ~ "Employed",     # Gov/Non-gov/Industrial/Daily laborer + Business/Farming/Agri worker/Other self-employed/Paid domestic
      A05 %in% c(10, 11, 13, 14, 15, 16)         ~ "Not Working",  # Student/Homemaker/Retired/Unemployed/Other
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    gender = case_when(
      A01 == 1 ~ "Male",
      A01 == 2 ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    residence_label = case_when(
      RESIDENCE == 1 ~ "Urban",
      RESIDENCE == 2 ~ "Rural",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
# Check demographic variables
ba_clean %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_gender = n_distinct(gender, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_education = n_distinct(education, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_residence = n_distinct(residence_label, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_employment = n_distinct(employment, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
# NOTE: reuses get_demo_counts_user3(), get_weighted_colpct_user3(), get_table1_pval()

# Bangladesh-specific demo_vars/var_labels used since Bangladesh's residence column
# is named "residence_label", not "residence" (as in Pakistan)

demo_vars_ba <- c("gender","age_group","education","employment","residence_label")

var_labels_ba <- c(
  gender          = "Gender",
  age_group       = "Age group",
  education       = "Education",
  employment      = "Employment",
  residence_label = "Residence"
)

cats <- c("Smoker","Smokeless","Dual")   # <-- was "Others"; now matches Pakistan
stopifnot(all(na.omit(unique(as.character(ba_clean$user3))) %in% cats))
ba_clean <- ba_clean %>% mutate(user3 = factor(user3, levels = cats))

table1_counts_ba   <- bind_rows(lapply(demo_vars_ba, function(v) get_demo_counts_user3(ba_clean, v)))
table1_weighted_ba <- bind_rows(lapply(demo_vars_ba, function(v) get_weighted_colpct_user3(ba_design, v)))

table1_pvals_ba <- bind_rows(lapply(demo_vars_ba, function(v) get_table1_pval(ba_design, v))) %>%
  mutate(Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, !!!var_labels_ba))

table1_joined_ba <- table1_counts_ba %>%
  left_join(table1_weighted_ba, by = c("Variable","Category")) %>%
  mutate(
    across(ends_with("_pct"), ~replace_na(., 0)),
    across(ends_with("_se"), ~replace_na(., 0)),
    Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, !!!var_labels_ba)
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(Variable, levels = unname(var_labels_ba)), Category) %>%
  left_join(table1_pvals_ba, by = "Variable") %>%
  group_by(Variable) %>%
  mutate(
    p        = if_else(row_number() == 1, p, ""),
    Variable = if_else(row_number() == 1, Variable, "")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

n_user3_ba <- ba_clean %>% filter(!is.na(user3)) %>% nrow()

table1_disp_ba <- table1_joined_ba %>%
  mutate(
    Smoker_pctSE    = fmt_pct_se(Smoker_pct,    Smoker_se),
    Smokeless_pctSE = fmt_pct_se(Smokeless_pct, Smokeless_se),
    Dual_pctSE      = fmt_pct_se(Dual_pct,      Dual_se)
  ) %>%
  select(Variable, Category, Category_Total,
         Smoker, Smoker_pctSE, Smokeless, Smokeless_pctSE, Dual, Dual_pctSE, p)

table1_disp_ba %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Table 1. Demographic characteristics by tobacco user type for Bangladesh",

      "Unweighted counts and survey-weighted column percentages (SE). ",

    )

  cols_label(
    Variable = "Variable", Category = "Category", Category_Total = "Row Total",
    Smoker = "n", Smoker_pctSE = "% (SE)",
    Smokeless = "n", Smokeless_pctSE = "% (SE)",

  tab_spanner(label = "Smokeless", id = "sp_Smokeless", columns = c(Smokeless, Smokeless_pctSE)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Dual", id = "sp_Dual", columns = c(Dual, Dual_pctSE)) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(Category_Total, Smoker, Smokeless, Dual), decimals = 0) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_column_labels(everything())) %>%
  tab_source_note("Note: Percentages are survey-weighted column percentages within each user type. 'Dual' refers to respondents who currently use both smoked and smokeless tobacco. p-values from design-adjusted (Rao-Scott) chi-square tests comparing smokers with smokeless tobacco users; dual users excluded owing to small cell sizes. Data: GATS Bangladesh 2017.")
```

```{r}
ensure_levels_ba <- function(des) {
  update(
    des,
    age_group  = factor(age_group, levels = c("15-24","25-44","45-64","65+")),
    gender     = factor(gender, levels = c("Female","Male")),
    education  = factor(education, levels = c("No Education","Primary or Less","Secondary or above")),
    residence_label = factor(residence_label, levels = c("Rural","Urban")),
    employment = factor(employment, levels = c("Not Working","Employed"))
  )
}
```

```{r}
# ---- Quit Attempts ------------------------------------------------------------
sl_clean <- sl_clean %>%
  mutate(
    quit_smoking = case_when(
      D01 == 1 ~ 1,
      D01 == 2 ~ 0,
      D01 == 9 | is.na(D01) ~ NA_real_
    ),
    quit_smokeless = case_when(
      D09 == 1 ~ 1,
      D09 == 2 ~ 0,
      D09 == 9 | is.na(D09) ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# ---- Quit Intentions -----------------------------------------------------------
sl_clean <- sl_clean %>%
  mutate(
    quit_smoking_intent = case_when(
      D08 %in% c(1, 2) ~ 1,
      D08 %in% c(3, 4) ~ 0,
      D08 %in% c(7, 9) | is.na(D08) ~ NA_real_
    ),
    quit_slt_intent = case_when(
      D16 %in% c(1, 2) ~ 1,
      D16 %in% c(3, 4) ~ 0,
      D16 %in% c(7, 9) | is.na(D16) ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```


```{r}
# ---- Tobacco User Type (already Smoker/Smokeless/Dual only — no waterpipe/e-cig module) ----
sl_clean <- sl_clean %>%
  mutate(
    smoker = if_else(
      B01 %in% c(1, 2) | B03 %in% c(1, 2) |
        rowSums(across(c(B06A, B06B, B06C, B06D,
                         B10A, B10B, B10C, B10D),
                       ~ . > 0 & . < 888), na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      1, 0, missing = 0
    ),
    smokeless = if_else(
      C01 %in% c(1, 2) | C03 %in% c(1, 2) |
        rowSums(across(c(C06A, C06B, C06C, C06D,
                         C10A, C10B, C10C, C10D),
                       ~ . > 0 & . < 888), na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      1, 0, missing = 0
    ),

    # Restricted classification — mirrors Pakistan exactly (was already close;
    # "Non-user" now becomes NA rather than its own category)
    user_type = case_when(
      smoker == 1 & smokeless == 1 ~ "Dual: Smoker + Smokeless",
      smoker == 1                  ~ "Smoker only",
      smokeless == 1               ~ "Smokeless only",
      TRUE                         ~ NA_character_   # non-users excluded
    ),

    user3 = case_when(
      user_type == "Smoker only"              ~ "Smoker",
      user_type == "Smokeless only"           ~ "Smokeless",
      user_type == "Dual: Smoker + Smokeless" ~ "Dual"
    ),
    dual_use = if_else(user_type == "Dual: Smoker + Smokeless", 1L, 0L)
  )

# User type distribution
sl_clean %>%
  count(user_type, name = "n", sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 2))

# Diagnostic: how many non-users now excluded?
sl_clean %>%
  filter(is.na(user_type)) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), pct_of_sample = round(100 * n / nrow(sl_clean), 2))
```


```{r}
# ---- Anti-Tobacco Exposure (using make_expo — consistent with Pakistan) -------
# NOTE: Sri Lanka's HWL columns are split by product: G202A (cig), G202B (bidi), G202C (SLT)
sl_clean <- sl_clean %>%
  mutate(
    anti_tob_expo = make_expo(., c("G201A1","G201B1","G201C1","G201D1","G201E1","G201F1","G202A","G202B",
                                   "G201A3","G201B3","G201C3","G201D3","G201E3","G201F3","G202C")),
    anti_cig_expo = make_expo(., c("G201A1","G201B1","G201C1","G201D1","G201E1","G201F1","G202A")),
    anti_slt_expo = make_expo(., c("G201A3","G201B3","G201C3","G201D3","G201E3","G201F3","G202C")),

    anti_cig_expo_label = factor(anti_cig_expo, levels = c(0,1),
                                 labels = c("Not exposed to anti-cigarette media",
                                            "Exposed to anti-cigarette media")),
    anti_slt_expo_label = factor(anti_slt_expo, levels = c(0,1),
                                 labels = c("Not exposed to anti-SLT media",
                                            "Exposed to anti-SLT media"))
  )
```

```{r}
# ---- Demographics ---------------------------------------------------------------
sl_clean <- sl_clean %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      AGE >= 15 & AGE <= 24 ~ "15-24",
      AGE >= 25 & AGE <= 44 ~ "25-44",
      AGE >= 45 & AGE <= 64 ~ "45-64",
      AGE >= 65             ~ "65+",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("15-24","25-44","45-64","65+")),

    # Collapsed to 3 categories — matches Pakistan
    education = case_when(
      A04 == 1            ~ "No Education",
      A04 %in% c(2, 3, 4) ~ "Primary or Less",
      A04 %in% c(5, 6, 7, 8) ~ "Secondary or above",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # Collapsed to 2 categories (self-employed folded into Employed) — matches Pakistan
    employment = case_when(
      A05 %in% c(1, 2, 3)       ~ "Employed",       # Govt + Non-govt + Self-employed
      A05 %in% c(4, 5, 6, 7, 8) ~ "Not Working",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

 gender = case_when(
      A01 == 1 ~ "Male",
      A01 == 2 ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    residence_label = case_when(
      residence == 1 ~ "Urban",
      residence == 2 ~ "Rural",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Check demographic variables
sl_clean %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_gender = n_distinct(gender, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_education = n_distinct(education, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_residence = n_distinct(residence_label, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_employment = n_distinct(employment, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# TABLE 1: DEMOGRAPHIC CHARACTERISTICS BY TOBACCO USER TYPE — SRI LANKA
# ==============================================================================
# Sri Lanka-specific demo_vars/var_labels since column is "residence_label"

demo_vars_sl <- c("gender","age_group","education","employment","residence_label")

var_labels_sl <- c(
  gender          = "Gender",
  age_group       = "Age group",
  education       = "Education",
  employment      = "Employment",
  residence_label = "Residence"
)

cats <- c("Smoker","Smokeless","Dual")   # <-- was "Others"; now matches Pakistan

stopifnot(all(na.omit(unique(as.character(sl_clean$user3))) %in% cats))

sl_clean <- sl_clean %>% mutate(user3 = factor(user3, levels = cats))

table1_counts_sl   <- bind_rows(lapply(demo_vars_sl, function(v) get_demo_counts_user3(sl_clean, v)))
table1_weighted_sl <- bind_rows(lapply(demo_vars_sl, function(v) get_weighted_colpct_user3(sl_design, v)))

table1_pvals_sl <- bind_rows(lapply(demo_vars_sl, function(v) get_table1_pval(sl_design, v))) %>%
  mutate(Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, !!!var_labels_sl))

table1_joined_sl <- table1_counts_sl %>%
  left_join(table1_weighted_sl, by = c("Variable","Category")) %>%
  mutate(
    across(ends_with("_pct"), ~replace_na(., 0)),
    across(ends_with("_se"), ~replace_na(., 0)),
    Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, !!!var_labels_sl)
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(Variable, levels = unname(var_labels_sl)), Category) %>%
  left_join(table1_pvals_sl, by = "Variable") %>%
  group_by(Variable) %>%
  mutate(
    p        = if_else(row_number() == 1, p, ""),
    Variable = if_else(row_number() == 1, Variable, "")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

n_user3_sl <- sl_clean %>% filter(!is.na(user3)) %>% nrow()
table1_disp_sl <- table1_joined_sl %>%
  mutate(
    Smoker_pctSE    = fmt_pct_se(Smoker_pct,    Smoker_se),
    Smokeless_pctSE = fmt_pct_se(Smokeless_pct, Smokeless_se),
    Dual_pctSE      = fmt_pct_se(Dual_pct,      Dual_se)
  ) %>%
  select(Variable, Category, Category_Total,
         Smoker, Smoker_pctSE, Smokeless, Smokeless_pctSE, Dual, Dual_pctSE, p)

table1_disp_sl %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Table 1. Demographic characteristics by tobacco user type for Sri Lanka",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Unweighted counts and survey-weighted column percentages (SE). ",
      "Analysis limited to non-missing user type (N = ", format(n_user3_sl, big.mark=","), ")."
    )
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Variable = "Variable", Category = "Category", Category_Total = "Row Total",
    Smoker = "n", Smoker_pctSE = "% (SE)",
    Smokeless = "n", Smokeless_pctSE = "% (SE)",
    Dual = "n", Dual_pctSE = "% (SE)", p = "p-value"
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Smoker", id = "sp_Smoker", columns = c(Smoker, Smoker_pctSE)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Smokeless", id = "sp_Smokeless", columns = c(Smokeless, Smokeless_pctSE)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Dual", id = "sp_Dual", columns = c(Dual, Dual_pctSE)) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(Category_Total, Smoker, Smokeless, Dual), decimals = 0) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_column_labels(everything())) %>%
  tab_source_note("Note: Percentages are survey-weighted column percentages within each user type. 'Dual' refers to respondents who currently use both smoked and smokeless tobacco. p-values from design-adjusted (Rao-Scott) chi-square tests comparing smokers with smokeless tobacco users; dual users excluded owing to small cell sizes. Data: GATS Sri Lanka 2019.")
```

```{r}
ensure_levels_sl <- function(des) {
  update(
    des,
    age_group  = factor(age_group, levels = c("15-24","25-44","45-64","65+")),
    gender     = factor(gender, levels = c("Female","Male")),
    education  = factor(education, levels = c("No Education","Primary or Less","Secondary or above")),
    residence_label = factor(residence_label, levels = c("Rural","Urban")),
    employment = factor(employment, levels = c("Not Working","Employed"))
  )
}

smoker_types_sl <- c("Smoker only", "Dual: Smoker + Smokeless")
slt_types_sl    <- c("Smokeless only", "Dual: Smoker + Smokeless")

smokers_sl <- subset(sl_design, user_type %in% smoker_types_sl) %>% ensure_levels_sl()
slt_sl     <- subset(sl_design, user_type %in% slt_types_sl)    %>% ensure_levels_sl()

cat("Smokers (Sri Lanka):", nrow(smokers_sl$variables), "\n")
cat("SLT users (Sri Lanka):", nrow(slt_sl$variables), "\n")
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# MODELS — SMOKING & SMOKELESS (Sri Lanka), dual_use included as covariate
# ==============================================================================

model_smk_attempt_sl <- svyglm(
  quit_smoking ~ anti_cig_expo + dual_use + age_group + gender + education + residence_label + employment,
  design = smokers_sl, family = binomial(link = "logit")
)
model_smk_intent_sl <- svyglm(
  quit_smoking_intent ~ anti_cig_expo + dual_use + age_group + gender + education + residence_label + employment,
  design = smokers_sl, family = binomial(link = "logit")
)
model_slt_attempt_sl <- svyglm(
  quit_smokeless ~ anti_slt_expo + dual_use + age_group + gender + education + residence_label + employment,
  design = slt_sl, family = binomial(link = "logit")
)
model_slt_intent_sl <- svyglm(
  quit_slt_intent ~ anti_slt_expo + dual_use + age_group + gender + education + residence_label + employment,
  design = slt_sl, family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

summary(model_smk_attempt_sl)
summary(model_smk_intent_sl)
summary(model_slt_attempt_sl)
summary(model_slt_intent_sl)
```

```{r}
n_total_sl <- nrow(GATS_SL_raw)

tobacco_user_flow_sl <- GATS_SL_raw %>%

    smoker_flow = if_else(
      B01 %in% c(1, 2) | B03 %in% c(1, 2) |
        rowSums(across(c(B06A, B06B, B06C, B06D,
                         B10A, B10B, B10C, B10D),
                       ~ . > 0 & . < 888), na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      1, 0, missing = 0
    ),
    smokeless_flow = if_else(
      C01 %in% c(1, 2) | C03 %in% c(1, 2) |
        rowSums(across(c(C06A, C06B, C06C, C06D,
                         C10A, C10B, C10C, C10D),
                       ~ . > 0 & . < 888), na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      1, 0, missing = 0
    ),
    any_tobacco_user = if_else(smoker_flow == 1 | smokeless_flow == 1, 1, 0)
  )

                     sl_media_slt_cols, sl_hwl_slt_col)), is.na)

cat("Sri Lanka — Analytic sample:", n_analytic_sl,
```

```{r}
core_vars <- c(
  "gatscluster", "gatsstrata", "gatsweight",
  "quit_smoking", "quit_smokeless", "quit_smoking_intent", "quit_slt_intent",
  "user_type", "user3", "smoker", "smokeless", "dual_use",
  "anti_tob_expo", "anti_cig_expo", "anti_slt_expo",
  "age_group", "gender", "education", "employment", "residence_label",
  "country"
)

all_available <- TRUE
for (var in core_vars) {
  has <- c(var %in% names(data_clean), var %in% names(in_clean),
           var %in% names(ba_clean), var %in% names(sl_clean))
  cat(sprintf("%-20s: PK=%s IN=%s BA=%s SL=%s %s\n", var,
              ifelse(has[1],"✓","✗"), ifelse(has[2],"✓","✗"),
              ifelse(has[3],"✓","✗"), ifelse(has[4],"✓","✗"),
              ifelse(all(has), "OK", "MISSING")))
  if (!all(has)) all_available <- FALSE
}
stopifnot(all_available)
```

```{r}
summary(model_smk_attempt_pooled)
summary(model_smk_intent_pooled)
summary(model_slt_attempt_pooled)
summary(model_slt_intent_pooled)
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS (dual_use added to recode map)
# ==============================================================================

tidy_or <- function(model) {
  broom::tidy(model, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(`OR (95% CI)` = ifelse(
      term == "(Intercept)", "",
      paste0(round(estimate, 2), " (", round(conf.low, 2), "\u2013", round(conf.high, 2), ")",
             ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", ""))
    )) %>%
    select(term, `OR (95% CI)`)
}

recode_terms_pooled <- function(df, exposure_term, exposure_label) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      Level = dplyr::recode(term,
        "(Intercept)"                       = "Intercept",
        !!exposure_term                     := exposure_label,
        "dual_use"                          = "Dual use",
        "age_group25-44"                    = "25\u201344",
        "age_group45-64"                    = "45\u201364",
        "age_group65+"                      = "65+",
        "genderMale"                        = "Male",
        "educationPrimary or Less"          = "Primary or Less",
        "educationSecondary or above"       = "Secondary or above",
        "residence_labelUrban"              = "Urban",
        "employmentEmployed"                = "Employed",
        "countryIndia"                      = "India",
        "countryBangladesh"                 = "Bangladesh",
        "countrySri Lanka"                  = "Sri Lanka",
        .default = term
      ),
      Predictor = case_when(
        Level == exposure_label                          ~ "Anti-Tobacco Exposure",
        Level == "Dual use"                               ~ "Dual Use",
        Level %in% c("25\u201344","45\u201364","65+")     ~ "Age Group",
        Level == "Male"                                    ~ "Gender",
        Level %in% c("Primary or Less","Secondary or above") ~ "Education",
        Level == "Urban"                                   ~ "Residence",
        Level == "Employed"                                 ~ "Employment",
        Level %in% c("India","Bangladesh","Sri Lanka")     ~ "Country",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
}

build_pooled_table <- function(model_attempt, model_intent, exposure_term, exposure_label,
                                table_num, table_title, outcome_span, footnote_text) {

  attempt_or <- tidy_or(model_attempt) %>% rename(`Quit Attempt OR (95% CI)` = `OR (95% CI)`)
  intent_or  <- tidy_or(model_intent)  %>% rename(`Quit Intention OR (95% CI)` = `OR (95% CI)`)

  combined <- attempt_or %>%
    full_join(intent_or, by = "term") %>%
    recode_terms_pooled(exposure_term, exposure_label)

  ref_rows <- tibble::tribble(
    ~Predictor,   ~Level,                      ~`Quit Attempt OR (95% CI)`, ~`Quit Intention OR (95% CI)`,
    "Age Group",  "15\u201324 (Reference)",    "", "",
    "Gender",     "Female (Reference)",        "", "",
    "Education",  "No Education (Reference)",  "", "",
    "Residence",  "Rural (Reference)",         "", "",
    "Employment", "Not Working (Reference)",   "", "",
    "Country",    "Pakistan (Reference)",      "", ""
  )

  final_tab <- bind_rows(
    ref_rows,
    combined %>% filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
      select(Predictor, Level, `Quit Attempt OR (95% CI)`, `Quit Intention OR (95% CI)`)
  ) %>%
    mutate(Predictor = factor(Predictor, levels = c(
      "Anti-Tobacco Exposure", "Dual Use", "Age Group", "Gender",
      "Education", "Residence", "Employment", "Country"))) %>%
    arrange(Predictor) %>%
    mutate(
      Level = if_else(is.na(Level), "", Level),
      Variable = case_when(
        grepl("\\(Reference\\)", Level) ~ paste0(as.character(Predictor), "  \u2014  ", Level),
        Level == ""                     ~ as.character(Predictor),
        TRUE                            ~ paste0("    ", Level)
      ),
      `Quit Attempt OR (95% CI)`   = if_else(is.na(`Quit Attempt OR (95% CI)`), "", `Quit Attempt OR (95% CI)`),
      `Quit Intention OR (95% CI)` = if_else(is.na(`Quit Intention OR (95% CI)`), "", `Quit Intention OR (95% CI)`)
    ) %>%
    select(Variable, `Quit Attempt OR (95% CI)`, `Quit Intention OR (95% CI)`)

  knitr::kable(final_tab, align = "lcc", na = "",
    caption = paste0("Table ", table_num, ". ", table_title)) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "left",
                              bootstrap_options = c("condensed"), font_size = 11) %>%
    kableExtra::column_spec(1, width = "9cm") %>%
    kableExtra::column_spec(2, width = "4.5cm") %>%
    kableExtra::column_spec(3, width = "4.5cm") %>%
    kableExtra::add_header_above(c(" " = 1, outcome_span = 2)) %>%
    kableExtra::footnote(general = footnote_text, footnote_as_chunk = TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
# SENSITIVITY: MODELS WITHOUT COUNTRY (dual_use retained — only 'country' dropped)
# ==============================================================================

model_smk_attempt_no_country <- svyglm(
  quit_smoking ~ anti_cig_expo + dual_use + age_group + gender + education + residence_label + employment,
  design = smokers_pooled, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
model_smk_intent_no_country <- svyglm(
  quit_smoking_intent ~ anti_cig_expo + dual_use + age_group + gender + education + residence_label + employment,
  design = smokers_pooled, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
model_slt_attempt_no_country <- svyglm(
  quit_smokeless ~ anti_slt_expo + dual_use + age_group + gender + education + residence_label + employment,
  design = slt_pooled, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
model_slt_intent_no_country <- svyglm(
  quit_slt_intent ~ anti_slt_expo + dual_use + age_group + gender + education + residence_label + employment,
  design = slt_pooled, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

compare_expo <- function(model_with, model_without, expo_term) {
  bind_rows(
    tidy(model_with, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>% filter(term == expo_term) %>% mutate(model = "With Country"),
    tidy(model_without, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>% filter(term == expo_term) %>% mutate(model = "Without Country")
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      OR_CI = paste0(round(estimate,2)," (",round(conf.low,2),"\u2013",round(conf.high,2),")"),
      p_value = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, "<0.001",
                       ifelse(p.value < 0.05, paste0(round(p.value,3),"*"), as.character(round(p.value,3))))
    ) %>%
    select(model, OR_CI, p_value)
}

comparison_smoking_attempts <- compare_expo(model_smk_attempt_pooled, model_smk_attempt_no_country, "anti_cig_expo")
comparison_smoking_intent   <- compare_expo(model_smk_intent_pooled,  model_smk_intent_no_country,  "anti_cig_expo")
comparison_slt_attempts     <- compare_expo(model_slt_attempt_pooled, model_slt_attempt_no_country, "anti_slt_expo")
comparison_slt_intent       <- compare_expo(model_slt_intent_pooled,  model_slt_intent_no_country,  "anti_slt_expo")

for (tbl in list(
  list(comparison_smoking_attempts, "Anti-Cigarette Exposure Effect on Quit Attempts"),
  list(comparison_smoking_intent,   "Anti-Cigarette Exposure Effect on Quit Intentions"),
  list(comparison_slt_attempts,     "Anti-SLT Exposure Effect on Quit Attempts"),
  list(comparison_slt_intent,       "Anti-SLT Exposure Effect on Quit Intentions")
)) {
  print(
    kable(tbl[[1]], col.names = c("Model","OR (95% CI)","p-value"), align = c("l","c","c"),
          caption = paste0("Comparison: ", tbl[[2]], " (With vs Without Country)")) %>%
      kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
      footnote(general = "* p < 0.05. Models adjusted for age, gender, education, residence, employment, and dual use.",
               footnote_as_chunk = TRUE)
  )
}

cat("\nLikelihood Ratio Tests:\n")
cat("Smoking Quit Attempts:\n");   print(anova(model_smk_attempt_no_country, model_smk_attempt_pooled))
cat("Smoking Quit Intentions:\n"); print(anova(model_smk_intent_no_country,  model_smk_intent_pooled))
cat("SLT Quit Attempts:\n");       print(anova(model_slt_attempt_no_country, model_slt_attempt_pooled))
cat("SLT Quit Intentions:\n");     print(anova(model_slt_intent_no_country,  model_slt_intent_pooled))
```

```{r}
run_model <- function(outcome, exposure, design) {
  tryCatch(
    svyglm(as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", exposure,
                            "+ dual_use + age_group + gender + education + residence_label + employment")),
           design = design, family = binomial()),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

# NOTE: smokers_pk/slt_pk/smokers_in/slt_in/smokers_ba/slt_ba/smokers_sl/slt_sl
# already exist from each country's harmonized script — reused directly here,
# NOT rebuilt, so we don't silently overwrite the dual_use-inclusive models
# you already ran country-by-country.

extract_expo_or <- function(model, expo_term) {
  if (is.null(model)) return("\u2014")
  tryCatch({
    est <- broom::tidy(model, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>% filter(term == expo_term)
    if (nrow(est) == 0) return("\u2014")
    paste0(round(est$estimate,2)," (",round(est$conf.low,2),"\u2013",round(est$conf.high,2),")",
           ifelse(est$p.value < 0.05, "*", ""))
  }, error = function(e) "\u2014")
}

summary_tab <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Country, ~`Smk Quit Attempt`, ~`Smk Quit Intention`, ~`SLT Quit Attempt`, ~`SLT Quit Intention`,
  "Pakistan",
  extract_expo_or(model_smk_attempt_pk, "anti_cig_expo"), extract_expo_or(model_smk_intent_pk, "anti_cig_expo"),
  extract_expo_or(model_slt_attempt_pk, "anti_slt_expo"), extract_expo_or(model_slt_intent_pk, "anti_slt_expo"),
  "India",
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# POOLED ANALYTIC FLOW DIAGRAM — self-contained, computed from raw data
# ==============================================================================

compute_flow <- function(raw_df, smoker_expr, smokeless_expr, media_cols, hwl_cols, country_name) {
  df <- raw_df %>%
    mutate(
      smoker_flow    = !!smoker_expr,
      smokeless_flow = !!smokeless_expr,
      any_tobacco_user = if_else(smoker_flow == 1 | smokeless_flow == 1, 1, 0)
    )

  n_total <- nrow(raw_df)
  n_any_user <- sum(df$any_tobacco_user)

  n_analytic <- df %>%
    filter(any_tobacco_user == 1) %>%
    filter(!is.na(D01) | !is.na(D09),
           !if_all(any_of(c(media_cols, hwl_cols)), is.na)) %>%
    nrow()

  tibble(country = country_name, n_total = n_total,
         n_tobacco_user = n_any_user, n_analytic = n_analytic)
}

flow_pk <- compute_flow(GATS_PK_raw,
  quote(if_else(B01 %in% c(1,2), 1, 0, missing = 0)),
  quote(if_else(C01 %in% c(1,2), 1, 0, missing = 0)),
  pk_media_smoke_cols, c(pk_hwl_smoke_col, pk_hwl_slt_col), "Pakistan")

flow_in <- compute_flow(GATS_IND_raw,
  quote(if_else(B01 %in% c(1,2) | B03 %in% c(1,2) |
    rowSums(across(c(B06A,B06B,B06C,B06E,B06F,B06G,B10A,B10B,B10C,B10E,B10F,B10G),
                   ~ . > 0 & . < 888), na.rm=TRUE) > 0, 1, 0, missing = 0)),
  quote(if_else(C01 %in% c(1,2) | C03 %in% c(1,2) |
    rowSums(across(c(C06A,C06B,C06C,C06D,C06E,C06F,C06G,C10A,C10B,C10C,C10D,C10E,C10F,C10G),
                   ~ . > 0 & . < 888), na.rm=TRUE) > 0, 1, 0, missing = 0)),
  in_media_smoke_cols, c(in_hwl_smoke_col, in_hwl_slt_col), "India")

flow_ba <- compute_flow(GATS_BA_raw,
  quote(if_else(B01 %in% c(1,2) | B03 %in% c(1,2) |
    rowSums(across(c(B06A,B06H,B06F,B06B,B06D,B06E,B06G,B10A,B10H,B10F,B10B,B10D,B10E,B10G),
                   ~ . > 0 & . < 888), na.rm=TRUE) > 0, 1, 0, missing = 0)),
  quote(if_else(C01 %in% c(1,2) | C03 %in% c(1,2) |
    rowSums(across(c(C06A,C06B,C06C,C06D,C06E,C06F,C06G,C10A,C10B,C10C,C10D,C10E,C10F,C10G),
                   ~ . > 0 & . < 888), na.rm=TRUE) > 0, 1, 0, missing = 0)),
  ba_media_smoke_cols, c(ba_hwl_smoke_col, ba_hwl_slt_col), "Bangladesh")

flow_sl <- compute_flow(GATS_SL_raw,
  quote(if_else(B01 %in% c(1,2) | B03 %in% c(1,2) |
    rowSums(across(c(B06A,B06B,B06C,B06D,B10A,B10B,B10C,B10D),
                   ~ . > 0 & . < 888), na.rm=TRUE) > 0, 1, 0, missing = 0)),
  quote(if_else(C01 %in% c(1,2) | C03 %in% c(1,2) |
    rowSums(across(c(C06A,C06B,C06C,C06D,C10A,C10B,C10C,C10D),
                   ~ . > 0 & . < 888), na.rm=TRUE) > 0, 1, 0, missing = 0)),
  sl_media_smoke_cols, c(sl_hwl_smoke_col, sl_hwl_slt_col), "Sri Lanka")

# Final restricted N (Smoker/Smokeless/Dual only) — pulled directly from each *_clean
flow_restricted <- tibble(
  country = c("Pakistan","India","Bangladesh","Sri Lanka"),
  n_restricted = c(
    data_clean %>% filter(!is.na(user_type)) %>% nrow(),
    in_clean   %>% filter(!is.na(user_type)) %>% nrow(),
    ba_clean   %>% filter(!is.na(user_type)) %>% nrow(),
    sl_clean   %>% filter(!is.na(user_type)) %>% nrow()
  )
)

flow_summary <- bind_rows(flow_pk, flow_in, flow_ba, flow_sl) %>%
  left_join(flow_restricted, by = "country") %>%
  mutate(
    n_excluded_no_data   = n_tobacco_user - n_analytic,
    n_excluded_othertype = n_analytic - n_restricted
  )

flow_summary

pooled_totals <- flow_summary %>%
  summarise(
    n_total        = sum(n_total),
    n_tobacco_user = sum(n_tobacco_user),
    n_analytic     = sum(n_analytic),
    n_restricted   = sum(n_restricted)
  )
pooled_totals
```

```{r}
  fmt_number(columns = c(n_total, n_tobacco_user, n_analytic, n_restricted), decimals = 0) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_column_labels(everything())) %>%
  tab_source_note("Final restricted sample excludes waterpipe-only, e-cigarette-only, and non-tobacco users; retains only Smoker only, Smokeless only, and Dual (Smoker + Smokeless) users.")
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
```
```{r}
# CONSOLIDATED TABLE 1: DEMOGRAPHIC CHARACTERISTICS OF POOLED ANALYTIC SAMPLE, BY COUNTRY
# ==============================================================================
# Mirrors the structure of get_demo_counts_user3()/get_weighted_colpct_user3(),
# but groups by country instead of user3. Also includes tobacco user type
# (Smoker/Smokeless/Dual) as its own variable block, so the table also reports
# what your original "Table 5" (user-type prevalence) did, in one place.

countries <- c("Pakistan", "India", "Bangladesh", "Sri Lanka")
demo_vars_pooled <- c("gender", "age_group", "education", "employment", "residence_label", "user3")

var_labels_pooled <- c(
  gender          = "Gender",
  age_group       = "Age Group",
  education       = "Education",
  employment      = "Employment",
  residence_label = "Residence",
  user3           = "Tobacco User Type"
)

# ---- Unweighted counts: Var x country ----------------------------------------
get_demo_counts_country <- function(df, var) {
  stopifnot(var %in% names(df))
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(country)) %>%
    mutate(`__cat__` = as.character(.data[[var]])) %>%
    filter(!is.na(`__cat__`)) %>%
    count(`__cat__`, country, name = "n") %>%
    complete(`__cat__`, country = factor(countries, levels = countries), fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = country, values_from = n) %>%
    mutate(
      Row_Total = rowSums(across(all_of(countries)), na.rm = TRUE),
      Variable  = var
    ) %>%
    rename(Category = `__cat__`) %>%
    select(Variable, Category, Row_Total, all_of(countries))
}

# ---- Weighted column % (+ SE), by country ------------------------------------
get_weighted_colpct_country <- function(design, var) {
  x     <- design$variables[[var]]
  x_fac <- factor(as.character(x))
  des_v <- do.call(update, c(list(design), setNames(list(x_fac), var)))
  levs  <- levels(x_fac)

  out <- data.frame(Category = levs, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  for (ctry in countries) {
    d_cat <- subset(des_v, country == ctry)
    if (length(weights(d_cat)) == 0) {
      est_vec <- rep(NA_real_, length(levs)); se_vec <- rep(NA_real_, length(levs))
    } else {
      est <- svymean(as.formula(paste0("~", var)), d_cat, na.rm = TRUE)
      se  <- SE(est)
      est_vec <- as.numeric(est) * 100
      se_vec  <- as.numeric(se)  * 100
      if (length(est_vec) != length(levs)) {
        nm <- names(est)
        lvl_from_names <- substring(nm, nchar(var) + 1)
        aligned <- rep(NA_real_, length(levs)); aligned_se <- rep(NA_real_, length(levs))
        for (i in seq_along(lvl_from_names)) {
          j <- match(lvl_from_names[i], levs)
          if (!is.na(j)) { aligned[j] <- est_vec[i]; aligned_se[j] <- se_vec[i] }
        }
        est_vec <- aligned; se_vec <- aligned_se
      }
    }
    out[[paste0(ctry, "_pct")]] <- est_vec
    out[[paste0(ctry, "_se")]]  <- se_vec
  }
  out$Variable <- var
  tibble::as_tibble(out)
}

# ---- Build ---------------------------------------------------------------------
table1_counts_pooled   <- bind_rows(lapply(demo_vars_pooled, function(v) get_demo_counts_country(pooled_data, v)))
table1_weighted_pooled <- bind_rows(lapply(demo_vars_pooled, function(v) get_weighted_colpct_country(pooled_design, v)))

table1_joined_pooled <- table1_counts_pooled %>%
  left_join(table1_weighted_pooled, by = c("Variable", "Category")) %>%
  mutate(
    across(ends_with("_pct"), ~replace_na(., 0)),
    across(ends_with("_se"),  ~replace_na(., 0)),
    Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, !!!var_labels_pooled)
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(Variable, levels = unname(var_labels_pooled)), Category) %>%
  group_by(Variable) %>%
  mutate(Variable = if_else(row_number() == 1, Variable, "")) %>%
  ungroup()

n_pooled_total <- pooled_data %>% filter(!is.na(country)) %>% nrow()

fmt_pct_se <- function(p, s) ifelse(is.na(p), "", sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", p, s))

table1_disp_pooled <- table1_joined_pooled %>%
  mutate(
    Pakistan_pctSE   = fmt_pct_se(Pakistan_pct, Pakistan_se),
    India_pctSE      = fmt_pct_se(India_pct, India_se),
    Bangladesh_pctSE = fmt_pct_se(Bangladesh_pct, Bangladesh_se),
    `Sri Lanka_pctSE`= fmt_pct_se(`Sri Lanka_pct`, `Sri Lanka_se`)
  ) %>%
  select(Variable, Category, Row_Total,
         Pakistan, Pakistan_pctSE,
         India, India_pctSE,
         Bangladesh, Bangladesh_pctSE,
         `Sri Lanka`, `Sri Lanka_pctSE`)

table1_disp_pooled %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Table 1. Demographic Characteristics of the Pooled Analytic Sample, by Country",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Unweighted counts and survey-weighted column percentages (SE). N = ",
      format(n_pooled_total, big.mark = ","), "."
    )
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Variable = "Variable", Category = "Category", Row_Total = "Row Total",
    Pakistan = "n", Pakistan_pctSE = "% (SE)",
    India = "n", India_pctSE = "% (SE)",
    Bangladesh = "n", Bangladesh_pctSE = "% (SE)",
    `Sri Lanka` = "n", `Sri Lanka_pctSE` = "% (SE)"
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Pakistan (2014)", id = "sp_pk", columns = c(Pakistan, Pakistan_pctSE)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "India (2016)", id = "sp_in", columns = c(India, India_pctSE)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Bangladesh (2017)", id = "sp_ba", columns = c(Bangladesh, Bangladesh_pctSE)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Sri Lanka (2019)", id = "sp_sl", columns = c(`Sri Lanka`, `Sri Lanka_pctSE`)) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(Row_Total, Pakistan, India, Bangladesh, `Sri Lanka`), decimals = 0) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_column_labels(everything())) %>%
  tab_source_note("Note: Percentages are survey-weighted column percentages within each country. Analytic sample restricted to Smoker only, Smokeless only, and Dual (Smoker + Smokeless) users. 'Tobacco User Type' reports the weighted prevalence of each user category within each country.")
```


```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# FIGURE: Prevalence of Tobacco User Types by Country (fully dynamic)
# ==============================================================================

# ---- Per-country weighted percentages, computed from pooled_design ----
usertype_by_country <- bind_rows(lapply(countries, function(ctry) {
  des_sub <- subset(pooled_design, country == ctry & !is.na(user3))
  est <- svymean(~factor(user3), des_sub, na.rm = TRUE)
  tibble(
    country = ctry,
    user_type = gsub("factor\\(user3\\)", "", names(est)),
    pct = round(as.numeric(est) * 100, 1)
  )
}))

# ---- Pooled row, computed from the FULL pooled_design (not a simple mean of the four) ----
usertype_pooled <- {
  des_all <- subset(pooled_design, !is.na(user3))
  est <- svymean(~factor(user3), des_all, na.rm = TRUE)
  tibble(
    country = "Pooled Sample",
    user_type = gsub("factor\\(user3\\)", "", names(est)),
    pct = round(as.numeric(est) * 100, 1)
  )
}

# ---- Combine and set factor levels/order ----
usertype_summary <- bind_rows(usertype_pooled, usertype_by_country) %>%
  mutate(
    country = factor(country, levels = c("Pooled Sample", "India", "Bangladesh", "Sri Lanka", "Pakistan")),
    user_type = factor(user_type, levels = c("Smokeless", "Smoker", "Dual"))
  )

# ---- Plot ----
ggplot(usertype_summary, aes(x = country, y = pct, fill = user_type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct, "%")), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 4, fontface = "bold", color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Smokeless" = "#E8A2A0",   # dusty rose
    "Smoker"    = "#C44E4E",   # brick red
    "Dual"      = "#6E1F1F"    # dark maroon
  )) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(title = "Prevalence of Tobacco User Types", x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 15),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11)
  )
```
